Following his stage win and conquest of the Maillot Jaune, Fausto Coppi triumphed in Italy, as the race headed to Sestrières.
Today marks the 26th stage start from the city. The last one, in 2022 (stage 13), smiled on Denmark: Mads Pedersen took his maiden Tour stage win in Saint-Étienne while Joans Vingegaard wore the Maillot Jaune on his way to his first overall victory.
Le Bourg d’Oisans witnessed one stage finish: Luis Otaño soloed to victory on day 15 of the Tour 1966, after summiting alone Col d’Ornon (yesterday’s penultimate climb).José Felix Parra won the final stage of the Alpes Isère Tour 2024 in Le Bourg d’Oisans but the Caja Rural-Seguros RGA climber left the Tour earlier this week due to a wrist On paper, that means eight riders can still edge Richard Carapaz (EF Education-EasyPost), all the way to Mauro Schmid (Jayco AlUla), who has 22 points. Mainly, the battle for the mountains classification mostly concerns Carapaz (91 points), Tadej Pogacar (90 points), and Valentin Paret-Peintre (84 points).
Since the polka-dot jersey was introduced in 1975, a rider claimed it on the penultimate stage four times, beginning with Giancarlo Bellini in 1976 at Lucien Van Impe’s expense.
More recently, Carapaz and Pogacar were the main protagonists of these last minute conquests. In 2020, the Slovenian took the polka-dot jersey with the stage win at La Planche des Belles Filles that also granted him his first Maillot Jaune. Four years later, Carapaz took his revenge on the antepenultimate stage of the Tour."],"slug":"a-kom-festival","pinned":false,"createdAt":"2026-07-25T11:51:23+02:00","_id":"4b37bfdf4b92990d4c437ea2406ff22447f15194d7fdf9e9045e2551c28a85b8","_bind":"publication_en-2026-20","_origin":"news-2026-20","_updatedAt":1784973083915,"_parent":"stage-2026:6fd61462168b294550703b0e4f2906d0c7d41a3be64930e8f64b14880f05f80c","_key":"_id","_virtual":"news:a-kom-festival","model":"news"},{"publicationAt":"2026-07-25T11:28:11+02:00","year":2026,"locale":"en","type":"liv","updatedBy":"bvittek","highlight":false,"updatedAt":"2026-07-25T11:28:11+02:00","picto":"liv_white_jersey","stage":20,"title":"White jersey","slug":"white-jersey-55","pinned":false,"text":["Isaac del Toro gained a handful of Paul Seixas seconds yesterday at L’Alpe d’Huez and now leads the young riders standings with a gap of 24 seconds. they head to Col de la Croix de Fer early in the stage, the riders ride through the territory of Vaujany, whose station is connected to L’Alpe d’Huez. Several events have held stages here: Paris-Nice, Tour cycliste féminin, and, most recently, the Critérium du Dauphiné (now known as Tour Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes), in 2022.
That year, stage 7 started in Saint-Chaffrey, passed the Col du Galibier and the Col du Télégraphe, before a final 6-km climb at Vaujany. Carlos Verona was the only rider from the breakaway to resist the GC contenders, claiming his first professional victory ahead of Primoz Roglic, Jonas Vingegaard, Ben O’Connor, and Tobias Johannessen."],"pinned":false,"slug":"an-early-visit-to-vaujany","createdAt":"2026-07-25T11:32:37+02:00","_id":"923e230c2848a11435e4e93d02d4ad0b4375e45913753adb39907a1367612946","_bind":"publication_en-2026-20","_origin":"news-2026-20","_updatedAt":1784971958214,"_parent":"stage-2026:6fd61462168b294550703b0e4f2906d0c7d41a3be64930e8f64b14880f05f80c","_key":"_id","_virtual":"news:an-early-visit-to-vaujany","model":"news"},{"onlyClubTab":false,"embedCode":"

On paper, that means eight riders can still edge Richard Carapaz (EF Education-EasyPost), all the way to Mauro Schmid (Jayco AlUla), who has 22 points. Mainly, the battle for the mountains classification mostly concerns Carapaz (91 points), Tadej Pogacar (90 points), and Valentin Paret-Peintre (84 points).

And this one is even harder than stage 19, even though the riders won’t tackle the legendary 21-hairpin that crowned Tadej Pogacar on Friday. Before that, they will pass Col de la Croix de Fer (HC), Col du Télégraphe (cat 1), and Col du Galibier (HC). Mainly, the battle for the mountains classification mostly concerns Carapaz (91 points), Tadej Pogacar (90 points), and Valentin Paret-Peintre (84 points).
Since the polka-dot jersey was introduced in 1975, a rider claimed it on the penultimate stage four times, beginning with Giancarlo Bellini in 1976 at Lucien Van Impe’s expense.
More recently, Carapaz and Pogacar were the main protagonists of these last minute conquests. the start of stage 20, French riders are yet to win a stage. It has only happened twice in history, and these references are not good omens for local heroes: the Tours 1926 and 1999 are the only ones in history with no victory for France. Can this year’s contenders flip the script?
